agents.name: Planner
agents.role: picks at most MAX_PLAN_STEPS named queries for the task, with a why for each

agents.name: Analyst
agents.role: turns the plan's query results into findings that cite a run_query_id for every number

agents.name: Evaluator
agents.role: checks citations, the guard and coverage in code, then scores the draft out of 9

agents.name: Writer
agents.role: writes the owner's review from the accepted findings; code checks every number

error.message: No remembered review has review_run_id "example_3a": only a review that passed the Evaluator is remembered.
